[[Category:Civil liability| ]]
'''Civil liability''' refers to the legal obligation to repair undue damages caused by a [[legal entity]] to another one.<ref>{{#cite:Q3952}}</ref>

The two main forms are:

* [[contractual liability]]
* [[tortious liability]]

== Obligor and obligee ==

If A is civilly liable to B, then A is called an '''obligor''' to '''obligee''' B.

In French law, the equivalent terms are '''débiteur·euse''' and '''créancier·ère'''.<ref>{{#cite:Q3952}}</ref>

== Repair ==

In most modern [[jurisdiction]]s, repair of damages is either done

* in kind, by repairing or replacing the damage
* via financial compensation
